concepts.name: Fractions
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Fractions'.
concepts.evidence: She says that 1 3 of one of her chocolates is bigger than 1 2 of the other chocolate.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Using chapter information to support an explanation or answer.
concepts.evidence: When can we say that 1 2 of something is greater than 1 3 of something?

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Using the chapter idea in a new but related situation.
concepts.evidence: To compare two fractions of two wholes, the wholes from which the fractions are derived must be the same.
